items.name: 988 Suicide & Crisis Lifeline
items.text: Call or text 988, or chat at 988lifeline.org. 24/7, free.

items.name: Crisis Text Line
items.text: Text HOME to 741741. Also web chat and WhatsApp. 24/7.

items.name: Frontier Behavioral Health crisis line
items.text: 1-877-266-1818, 24/7. Spokane and 5 nearby counties; can send a mobile crisis team.

items.name: Walk in
items.text: Frontier Behavioral Health, 107 S Division St, Spokane. Mon–Fri 7:30 am–4:30 pm; at other times call the crisis line above.
items.check: hours Mon-Fri 7:30 am-4:30 pm: call 1-877-266-1818 or check fbhwa.org

sections.title: Talk to a peer (not a crisis line)

items.name: Trans Lifeline
items.text: (877) 565-8860, Mon–Fri 10 am–6 pm Pacific. Trans peers; no police or emergency calls without your consent.

items.name: WA Warm Line
items.text: 877-500-9276, daily 2–9 pm. Peers with lived experience; up to 20 minutes, once a day.

items.name: The Trevor Project
items.text: Text START to 678-678, call 1-866-488-7386, or chat. 24/7, for LGBTQ+ young people.

items.name: National Alliance for Eating Disorders
items.text: (866) 662-1235, Mon–Fri 6 am–4 pm Pacific. Answered by eating-disorder therapists. Email info@allianceforeatingdisorders.com.
